messages.subject: Additive models
parts:
Dear rkoholiki,

For the people who are interested in the next meeting about additive
models (AM) I will work with the book of Zuur et al 2009 (Mixed Effects
Models and Extensions in Ecology with R). The theory behing AMs are well
explained in chapter 3. During my presentation I will go not very deeply
into the mathematical background, so who is interested can read the
chapter in the book or when you don't have the book (yet) you can use
google books:
http://books.google.com/books?id=vQUNprFZKHsC&pg=PA10&dq=zuur+et+al+2009&cd=1#v=onepage&q=zuur%20et%20al%202009&f=false
It shows the theoratical part of the book.

Furthermore, I will show the example in the book. Therefore it will be
very useful, if you have your own laptop to download the zip file with
the data package that Alain Zuur created for the book. See
http://www.highstat.com/book2.htm for the zip file. Furthermore we will
need the library "mgcv".

Hope to see you all,

Kind regards,

Maarten
